question.prompt: Which concrete runtime values should fill {{publish_test_book_title}}, {{publish_test_author_name}}, {{publish_test_author_email}}, and {{nonexistent_package_slug}} so the browser tests can run reproducibly?

options.label: Fill new variables
options.detail: Keep the authored tests and populate the four declared variables with stable CI values before execution.

options.label: Map replacements
options.detail: Provide replacement variable names or fixture values to use instead of the new variables.

options.label: Rework data plan
options.detail: Provide a different test-data strategy and rework the affected tests around it.

content.risk_rationale: The package-list and 404 tests are structurally complete, but they cannot execute reproducibly until stable submission data and a guaranteed nonexistent package slug are supplied. This blocks runtime, not the coverage design itself.
